simple.meaning: עוּז (ʻûwz) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be strong ; causatively, to strengthen , i.e. (figuratively) to save (by flight).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Exodus, Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at Exodus 9:19. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עוּז (H5756).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
